text:
maria: deploy-bot reported completed for canary on v2026.03.17. rolling to prod now.

deploy-bot: AUTO: Rollout started: service=api variant=v2026.03.17 mode=zero-backoff

kevin: seeing p95 jump on prod-api within 30s of canary cutover. mostly timeouts (504s) and backend 5xx.

sre-oncall: paging in. what's the canary percentage? any config changes? :eyes:

maria: canary at 100% now (accidentally left thermal). didn't change config besides zero-backoff tuning for connection backpressure.

kevin: logs show request_queue growth and lots of `request timeout waiting for kv cache` traces. attaching quick snippet:
```
2026-03-17T21:12:05Z ERROR handler.go:142 timeout waiting for kvCache.Get
2026-03-17T21:12:05Z WARN router.go:78 multiplexer queue len=420
```

infra: rolling-probes show increased tail latency on GPU nodes. maybe batching/kvcache affinity broke with zero-backoff.

ops-lead: customer-impact? CS seeing errors from a small set of tenants, but number of failed requests doubled. we should consider rollback now.

customer-success: a few enterprise customers reported conversation hangs. low volume but high impact on latency-sensitive flows.

sre-oncall: agree with rollback. patch: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=3` ? anyone confirm runbook step?

kevin: I'm starting rollback now. running:
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --namespace=prod --to-revision=3 && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -w`

deploy-bot: AUTO: Rollout undo triggered by kevin at 21:15:18

maria: monitoring... p95 dropping back within 90s. 504s count decreasing.

sre-oncall: nice. open incident page and notify customers. I'll take postmortem. tagging eng-runtime for follow-up.

ops-lead: action items: revert zero-backoff change, add canary guardrail for queue growth, add metric alert for `router.queue_len > 200`.

customer-success: sending proactive note to affected customers. thanks for the quick rollback :thumbsup:

maria: filing a short incident report and linking perf traces. will own remediation.

sre-oncall: thanks team — handoff to postmortem channel. closing this thread.
